findings.evidence: The launch block is copied verbatim in references/launch-and-wait.md lines 29 and 85, and the no-trailing-& rule exists only in that reference.
findings.fix: Keep one canonical launch block in SKILL.md section 2. In references/launch-and-wait.md, point at that block and state only the host difference: on Claude Code the command is the background task and must not end with &; every other host runs it in the foreground.

findings.evidence: Two timeouts, not one, and gsd-core's default is 300 s when the config key is absent.
findings.fix: Add the failure mode: --timeout only lowers the inner deadline and cannot raise the outer cap, which stays min(CONFIG outerTimeoutS, workflow.cross_ai_timeout or 300s), so setting only --timeout leaves the outer cap in place.

findings.evidence: The run-lock and hosted-sweep text (lines 113-121) is always loaded, including the 2s re-read, rename claim, and secret-file deletion order.
findings.fix: Keep in SKILL.md the caller actions and exact messages (locked, stale lock, kept run.json, sweep summary, herdr screen is not a verdict, --sweep ignores host none and still needs herdr). Move the lock-file schema and sweep algorithm to references/subprocess-quota-policy.md, and gate that section: read it when status=locked, a line starts with cross-ai: host or cross-ai: sweep, or a close was not confirmed; do not load it for a plain launch and read.

findings.evidence: --argv-file is specified only as constraints (JSON array, 65536 bytes, placeholders {model}, {effort}, {session}) with no exact argv.
findings.fix: Add one owner-approved example: ["placeholder-cli-1","--model","{model}"] passed as --argv-file argv.json, prompt still on stdin. Say a review-role lane is only as confined as that command, and launch it only inside a git work tree.

findings.evidence: The file has 8 should-trigger and 8 should-not-trigger queries, and every should-trigger query names the runner, cross-ai, herdr, or an argv file.
findings.fix: Add two should-trigger queries that do not name the runner (a pi lane that printed retry_after_s=600; an execute lane with status=partial and reason=task_uncovered) and two near-miss should-not queries (edit the runner template cross-ai.mjs; call opencode directly without the runner).

findings.evidence: No eval covers exit 75 with retry_after_s=; the closest case, edge-locked-is-a-bare-75, has no retry_after_s.
findings.fix: Add a lane.err fixture with status=transient, exit=75, and retry_after_s=600, and assertions that the caller waits one cycle only, re-invokes the same runtime and model, never switches CLI, and if it schedules CronCreate does not pin the fire to minute 0 or 30.

findings.evidence: Wait once, for exactly retry_after_s seconds, then re-invoke is followed by: Where Claude Code's CronCreate is callable, schedule one one-shot job at retry_after_s.
findings.fix: Make the paths exclusive. If CronCreate is callable and retry_after_s is at least 60, schedule one one-shot at the first whole minute at or after that delay that is not :00 or :30, confirm the tool's printed next run, and stop without also blocking. Otherwise print retry_after_s, the state-file path, and the re-invoke command, and stop. Never block and schedule.

findings.evidence: The sample AIKIT-XAI line ends at escalate=- and omits coverage= and findings=, which SKILL.md says the last line always carries after escalate=.
findings.fix: Append coverage=- findings=- to the sample status lines in references/launch-and-wait.md and in evals/files/session-ok/lane.err so they match the field order in SKILL.md section 4.
